summary: No SPY bet: a +1.1% gap up on chip and AI headlines into the Anthropic listing; the gap is priced at the open and the last four sessions peaked in the opening minutes.
reasons: Pre-market (Webull, 08:32 ET): SPY +1.14%, QQQ +1.95%, SMH +2.7%, IGV +2.7%, IWM +0.6%; defensives red (XLP -0.7%, XLV -0.5%). VIXY -3.2%.

Why up: Anthropic (ANT) lists on Nasdaq today (Benzinga: futures rise as Wall Street awaits the listing); Benzinga 07:32 ET: the Commerce Department expedited H200 China export approvals for NVIDIA (NVDA pre-market +1.5%; I could not confirm it elsewhere, and a web result says NVIDIA halted H200 sales as the 11-16 export rule takes effect today); Intel's first external 18A customer and Microsoft as a packaging customer (INTC +4.5%); MU +5% (RBC: tighter memory supply through 2028), GOOGL +3.8%, AMZN +2.3% (both hold Anthropic stakes).

08:30 jobless claims and the Philadelphia Fed survey: I could not find the prints in the sources I have (web search and Webull news returned nothing dated today). SPY did not move on them: 738.83 at 07:42, 738.51 at 08:32.

R1: the gap is in the opening price; open to close is what p_up measures, and 11-13, 11-16, 11-17 and 11-18 all made their high in the first minutes. A one-day unwind of the month's rotation (chips and software up, staples down) has reversed intraday before; nothing known this morning tells whether it holds. p_up 0.48, no bet.

Yesterday (Benzinga): S&P 500 flat, dollar index 103.79 (a 19-month high, seventh gain in a row), oil -5.1%, gold -2.9%, Treasury yields lower. This morning by ETF only: TLT -0.3% (yields up a little), USO +1.9%, UUP +0.0%. Web search returned nothing dated today, so there are no futures, VIX, yield or crude levels in this file.

Sniper null: no rating or target change qualifies. AVGO (Goldman keeps Buy, adjusts its target) gaps +2.8%, over the ~1.5% limit for a target change; HD (DA Davidson raises to $390, Barclays cuts to $412) is red pre-market; Cantor only maintains its NVDA target. Since last night R4 reads 'a rating change is in the price by 09:32' (two years, 219 upgrades: +0.04% from 09:32), so the class is named for shadow samples only.

Report window (R3): WMT reported this morning (beat, raised the year, -1.6% pre-market): no idea on it today or tomorrow. NVDA reported 11-17 after the close, so today is its second session after: allowed. AVGO reports 12-09. No >= 2% pre-market down gap in the rebound_scanner universe.

Dossiers: AMD +2.7% pre-market after +5.3% yesterday on the OpenAI chip-design note; nothing new of its own this morning. META +1.6%: it suspended new Class C issuance pending a court ruling; no product news.
Theme states at the 11-18 close: chips neutral with two turn flags, software turning (three flags), breadth light lit. Described, not forecast (R6).

inputs.overnight: No dated overnight coverage found by web search; Benzinga via Alpaca and Webull only. Dollar index 103.79 at Wednesday's close.

rotation.note: Over a month money sat in consumer and staples while memory, GPU, optical, disk and CPU lost 20-32%. This morning is the reverse of that: chips +3%, software +2.6%, staples and Walmart red. One morning; the map describes and does not forecast.

opportunities.why: Commerce expedited H200 China export approvals (Benzinga 07:32 ET, not confirmed elsewhere); second session after its report, which was sold -5.2% open to close; gap only +1.5%
opportunities.why_zh: 消息说美国商务部加快批准英伟达 H200 芯片对华出口（只有一个来源，没法另外证实）。财报后昨天从开盘被卖了 5%，今天盘前只高开 1.5%

opportunities.why: First external customer for 18A and Microsoft named for advanced packaging; gap +4.5% is past the line where a pre-market catalyst counts as priced
opportunities.why_zh: 英特尔最先进的 18A 工艺拿到第一个外部客户，微软成为先进封装客户。但盘前已经高开 4.5%，好消息可能已经在价格里

opportunities.why: Anthropic lists today and Amazon is one of its largest holders; +2.3% pre-market after +3.8% yesterday, so the listing may be the day the news is sold
opportunities.why_zh: Anthropic 今天上市，亚马逊是大股东之一。昨天已涨 3.8%，今天盘前再涨 2.3%，上市当天也可能是“利好出尽”

zh.summary: 今天不下注。标普盘前高开约 1.1%、纳指约 1.9%，靠的是芯片和 AI 的消息加上 Anthropic 今天上市；但高开那一段开盘就已经算进价格里，而且过去四天都是开盘几分钟就见当天高点。8:30 的初请失业金和费城联储数据我没查到具体数字，但标普在数据前后没动。
zh.sniper: 今天不点名。没有合格的评级或目标价变动：博通只是高盛调目标价，但盘前已涨 2.8%，超过线；家得宝两家券商一升一降。另外昨晚用两年数据验过：评级变动到 9:32 就已经在价格里，之后买等于抛硬币，所以这一类现在只为攒影子样本。
